description: DEVELOPMENT SET. Used to design value linking (these are the examples that motivated it), so it is not evidence of generalisation: report it separately from, and never instead of, the held-out chinook_values.json. Questions over the Pagila fixture where the user does not type a value the way it is stored (abbreviation, alias, typo, plural, punctuation, case), plus values that do not exist. Conventions: every question is a COUNT, so an answer is one number; a value that is not stored has the right answer 0, accepted either as a count of 0 or as no rows ('count' and 'no_rows' gold answers), and must never be 'corrected' to a similar stored value; a country means country.country through customer -> address -> city -> country; a film's category is category.name through film_category; a rating is film.rating. `expected` rows are a snapshot of the gold SQL (python -m dev_tools.evals snapshot). Do not edit a case, a gold query or an expected row after seeing a result.

cases.question: How many customers are from the USA?
cases.description: country.country stores 'United States'; 'USA' shares no characters with it.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id WHERE co.country = 'United States'

cases.question: How many Drama films are rated PG-13?

cases.question: How many customers are from Norway?
cases.description: Norway is a real country that country.country does not hold. The answer is zero and must not be 'corrected' to a similar stored country.

gold.label: count
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id WHERE co.country = 'Norway'

gold.label: no_rows
gold.sql: SELECT co.country, COUNT(*) FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id WHERE co.country = 'Norway' GROUP BY co.country

cases.question: How many films are in the Western category?
cases.description: There is no Western category. The answer is zero and must not be 'corrected' to a similar stored category.

gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_category fc JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Western'

gold.label: no_rows
gold.sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM film_category fc JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Western' GROUP BY c.name
